To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) DNA extraction using the FastDNA® SPIN Kit for soil was found to be the most efficient method for the recovery of ARGs from WWTP samples; (2) sample preservation using 50% ethanol, followed by freezing and overseas shipment had little impact on the recovery of ARG genes; and (3) ARG profiles obtained from DNA extracted using the FastDNA SPiN Kit for Soil, with and without sample preservation, were similar.
The DNA extraction method (FastDNA® SPIN Kit for Soils, PowerSoil, and ZR Feces) has significant impact on the ARG profiles and diversity of ARG profiles.
the FastDNA® SPIN Kit for soil, without sample preservation, was the best choice for ARG detection in wastewater samples.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the effects of sample preservation and different DNA extraction kits on the enumeration of ARGs in wastewater, which are important considerations for the development of standardized protocols for the analysis of wastewater‐derived metagenomes.
the effects of preservation and DNA extraction methods on the enumeration of antibiotic resistance gene in wastewater.
the effects of sample preservation and different DNA extraction methods on the enumeration of antibiotic resistance gene in the influent, effluent and activated sludge samples of two WWTP.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the FastDNA SPiN Kit for Soil is the best choice of DNA extraction method, and that sample preservation and shipment do not affect ARG distributions.
the FastDNA SPIn Kit for Soil is the most efficient method for DNA extraction of ARGs from wastewater, followed by the PowerSoil DNA Isolation Kit.
the FastDNA SPin Kit for Soil is recommended for the DNA extraction of wastewater samples for ARG profiling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the FastDNA® SPIN Kit for soil is the preferred method for ARGs profiling in WWTPs.

the DNA extraction methods, preservation and shipping methods have no effect on ARG profiles in wastewater, and the FastDNA® SPIN Kit for soil is the preferred method for all three types of wastewater samples.

DNA extraction using the FastDNA SPINS Kit for Soil method with fresh samples would be the best choice for metagenomic profiling of ARGs in WWTPs, while sample fixation in 50% (v/v) ethanol, deep‐frozen storage and international shipment would not affect the ARG profile.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the FastDNA® SPIN Kit for Soils is a reliable and reproducible method for extracting high‐quality DNA from a wide range of environmental samples.
the FastDNA® Spin Kit is an effective and efficient method for DNA extraction from wastewater and sludge samples.
the FastDNA SPiN Kit for Soil can be used for DNA extraction of wastewater samples for ARG profiling.
